title: core.quality.row_dedup
description: Row-level deduplication metrics for a dataset. A duplicate row is a row whose combination of all column values has already appeared in the dataset. Scope is always DATASET.

unique_rows.description: Number of rows with a distinct combination of all column values.

duplicate_rows.description: Number of excess rows: total_rows - unique_rows. These are the rows that could be dropped without losing any information.
